observations: A cream/beige fabric two-seater couch photographed from two similar high angles in what looks like a tiled room corner.
Seat appears as one continuous cushion with no visible separation seams for two seats.
Fabric shows some discoloration/shadowing patches, especially visible in photo 1 near the backrest.
No brand tag, label, or model marking visible in either photo.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GREGEZE97' overlays both images; this is a listing watermark, not proof of condition.
No photos of the underside, legs/frame, zippers, or any tears/stains close-up.
No photo showing the couch from a full frontal or side angle to judge true dimensions or shape.

claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows visible discoloration/shadow patches on the backrest fabric that are inconsistent with a 'very neat' description.

risks.risk: Fabric staining or dirt beyond what is visible due to photo angle/lighting
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seat cushion, backrest, and armrests in bright, even light
risks.if_unproven: priced as visibly stained/used condition, not 'very neat'

risks.risk: Frame or leg damage, wobbling, or missing parts hidden under the couch
risks.proof: Photo of the underside and all four legs/feet
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming frame condition unknown/worst case (possible structural issue)

risks.risk: Odor, mold, or moisture damage common in humid Lagos storage
risks.proof: Seller's close-up video or photo of cushion seams and underside fabric
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified, worst case assumed

risks.risk: Actual dimensions may not fit buyer's space
risks.proof: Tape-measure photo showing width, depth, and height
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard 2-seater size, unverified exact fit

risks.risk: Single fused cushion may indicate lower-quality or non-standard build misrepresented as a proper 2-seater sofa
risks.proof: Photo from a straight-on front angle showing cushion/seat divisions clearly
risks.if_unproven: priced as a basic/budget-style 2-seater, not a premium structured sofa

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit close-up photos of the fabric surface (seat, back, arms) to check for stains/wear
Photo of the underside and legs/frame
A straight-on front view and a side view of the full couch
A tape measure photo showing width and depth
A short video panning around the couch to check for odor-causing damp spots, tears, or structural looseness
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a 2-seater fabric couch, but the 'very neat' claim is contradicted by visible discoloration, and no views of the frame, underside, or close-up fabric condition exist, so it must be priced at worst-case used condition pending further proof.
